query: Bally's will contribute 1 percent of GGR annually (minimum $15 million) to a Community Benefits Fund from opening, administered by an independent local board.

facts.text: Bally's promised an annual Bronx community fund contribution of 1% of gross gaming revenue.
The Bronx fund contribution has a $15 million annual minimum.
Contributions are tied to casino opening rather than license award.
The Bronx community benefits fund was to be governed by an independent local board.
The negotiated fund board was to have eleven members.
The operator described appointments by local elected officials and Community Board 10.
The Board questioned the benefits package's $765 million net present value because the fund pays nothing before opening.

conditions.text: An independently governed local fund board was established.
Bally's made the annual fund payments due after opening at 1% of gross gaming revenue with a $15 million minimum.

reference_verdict.reasoning: §5 decision order: (1) payments can be evidenced; (2) the trigger (facility opening) is after the assessment date → not yet due. No document reports the fund entity or its board being set up, which is the only step that could happen before opening; if one does, it would be partial evidence. Gale had 2 articles ever mentioning the fund, none since Dec 2025. Re-assess at opening.
